import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1] if len(data) > 1 else ""
    
    ans = 0
    for center in range(n):
        i, j = center, center
        while i >= 0 and j < n and s[i] == s[j]:
            ans = max(ans, j - i + 1)
            i -= 1
            j += 1
        
        i, j = center, center + 1
        while i >= 0 and j < n and s[i] == s[j]:
            ans = max(ans, j - i + 1)
            i -= 1
            j += 1
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
